title: Table Talk with prompts.chat creator Fatih Kadir Akin
description:
prompts.chat creator, Fatih Kadir Akin, will share more of his story creating an open-source prompt library into a broader ecosystem. He will explain why prompts still matter in the age of agents, how they help define intent and context, and why open systems are important for collaboration, reuse, and better developer workflows. Join him for this table talk and hear his perspective as an open-source leader in the age of AI. 

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
